title: Publish portable command worker image
description: Produce a genuinely buildable Plexus-owned command-worker container artifact and immutable publication path. The image must install the executor dependencies needed by supported dashboard commands, pass a real container build and startup smoke test, and publish a digest consumed by the companion deployment. Do not modify the mixed infrastructure application, Amplify environment variables, or existing production resources.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
## Validation correction

The previously merged Dockerfile was checked from a clean develop snapshot. Its image build fails because the build invokes plexus-command-worker --help, while the entrypoint immediately requires runtime environment bindings. The existing test only inspects Dockerfile strings and did not build the image. PR #554 was closed without deployment. Terra should correct the artifact and add a real build/startup smoke test before publication work resumes.
